stories.headline: Economic development group backs Michigan City schools' referendum
stories.body: The Economic Development Corporation Michigan City board unanimously passed a resolution supporting MCAS's eight-year, up to $80 million operating referendum, which goes before district voters on the November 3 ballot. EDCMC Executive Director Clarence Hulse said a strong public school system underpins the city's workforce and growth plans.
